ios.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Cherry Studio reads and manages calendar events you request in chat, such as reviewing today's schedule or rescheduling a meeting, and sends relevant event details to your selected AI service.
ios.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Cherry Studio reads and manages calendar events you request in chat, such as reviewing today's schedule or rescheduling a meeting, and sends relevant event details to your selected AI service.
ios.NSCalendarsWriteOnlyAccessUsageDescripti: Cherry Studio adds calendar events you request in chat, such as a meeting tomorrow at 10 AM, using details from your selected AI service.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Cherry Studio sends your current location and address, when requested, to your selected AI service to answer questions such as finding nearby restaurants, only while you use the app.
ios.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: Cherry Studio reads and manages reminders you request in chat, such as listing today's tasks or adding a grocery reminder, and sends relevant reminder details to your selected AI service.
ios.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Cherry Studio reads and manages reminders you request in chat, such as listing today's tasks or adding a grocery reminder, and sends relevant reminder details to your selected AI service.
